cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're going to look at this cottage properly. We wanted somewhere to belong; start by showing me where it leaks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll choose every tile. Bring me the roof estimate before you show me a house somebody else has finished.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That estimate could take all our savings.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put the savings beside it and let's see. We were saving for a home; I want to know what that money can make ours, not how long we can keep looking.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 directs inspection through belonging hope; A3 orders estimate before other houses and reinterprets roof work as choosing each tile; A5 directs savings comparison as making a home theirs.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2 whole roof need to embrace personal choice; A5 uses B4 savings risk to return to the original purpose of saving.

relationship.evidence: B2 reports substantial repair and B4 financial exposure, plausible co-buyer concerns A cannot ignore.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 all-savings pressure to expand belonging from a place into what they have been preparing to spend for it.

specificity.evidence: A1 cottage viewing and A3 roof estimate make choices concrete; A5 compares costs without claiming purchase or affordability already settled.
